articles.author: Ananya Gairola
articles.headline: 'OpenAI Is Burning It Down With One Mag 7 After Another'— Apple's Trade Secret Lawsuit Has Tech Analysts Talking and Elon Musk Saying That 'Sounds Pretty Bad'
articles.summary: OpenAI drew criticism from Daniel Newman and Elon Musk after Apple sued the AI company over alleged trade secret theft.
articles._summary: Reacting to Apple’s lawsuit filed Friday in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California, Newman suggested OpenAI’s relationships with some of the world’s biggest technology companies are rapidly deteriorating. “OpenAI burning it down with one Mag 7 after another. First $MSFT and now $AAPL,” Newman wrote on X. His remarks came as Apple accused OpenAI of misappropriating trade secrets to accelerate the development of consumer AI devices.
articles._zh_headline: “OpenAI 正在用 Mag 7 来摧毁它”——苹果的商业秘密诉讼让技术分析师议论纷纷，埃隆·马斯克表示“听起来很糟糕”
articles._zh_summary: 针对苹果周五向美国加州北区地方法院提起的诉讼，纽曼表示 OpenAI 与一些全球最大科技公司的关系正在迅速恶化。纽曼在 X 上写道：“OpenAI 用一台又一台 Mag 7 烧毁了它。先是 $MSFT，现在是 $AAPL。”他发表此番言论之际，苹果公司指责 OpenAI 盗用商业机密以加速消费人工智能设备的开发。

articles.author: Mohd Haider
articles.headline: Elizabeth Warren Calls UAE Chip Export Rule 'Corrupt' as Commerce Department Eases Controls on Trump-Linked Stablecoin Deal
articles.summary: Commerce Department eased UAE chip export controls, offering favorable reviews for MGX and streamlined access for major tech firms.
articles._summary: The unpublished 17-page rule, which can be seen in the Federal Register, favors MGX, which used USD1 (CRYPTO: USD1) to fund its Binance stake. In a statement released Friday, Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) called the deal "corrupt," citing Trump’s reported $263 million gain tied to the arrangement, which was part of the $1.4 billion he earned from crypto ventures last year. She called on Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and Under Secretary Jeffrey Kessler to testify before the Senate Banking Committee.
articles._zh_headline: 伊丽莎白·沃伦 (Elizabeth Warren) 称阿联酋芯片出口规则“腐败”，因为商务部放松了对与特朗普相关的稳定币交易的控制
articles._zh_summary: 未发布的 17 页规则（可以在《联邦公报》中看到）有利于 MGX，该规则使用 1 美元（加密货币：USD1）为其币安股份提供资金。在周五发布的一份声明中，马萨诸塞州民主党参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦 (Elizabeth Warren) 称该交易“腐败”，并援引特朗普据报道与该安排相关的 2.63 亿美元收益，这是他去年从加密货币企业赚取的 14 亿美元的一部分。她呼吁商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克和副部长杰弗里·凯斯勒在参议院银行委员会作证。

articles.author: Chandrima Sanyal
articles.headline: New 'Ex-Elon' ETFs Would Strip Musk's Tesla And SpaceX From Major Indexes
articles.summary: New Ex-Elon ETFs exclude companies linked to Elon Musk, underscoring founder concentration as a growing ETF theme.
articles._summary: For decades, investors used index funds to diversify away company-specific risks. But the rise of mega-cap founders is creating a new challenge for passive investors: increasingly large exposure to a handful of influential individuals. The filing comes at a time when Musk’s footprint across passive portfolios is expanding rapidly. Tesla has been a member of the S&P 500 since 2020 and the Nasdaq-100 since 2013.
articles._zh_headline: 新的“Ex-Elon”ETF 将从主要指数中剔除马斯克旗下的特斯拉和 SpaceX
articles._zh_summary: 几十年来，投资者利用指数基金来分散公司特定的风险。但巨型股创始人的崛起给被动投资者带来了新的挑战：越来越多地接触少数有影响力的个人。该文件提交之际，马斯克在被动投资组合中的足迹正在迅速扩大。特斯拉自 2020 年起成为标准普尔 500 指数成员，自 2013 年起成为纳斯达克 100 指数成员。

articles.author: Chris Katje
articles.headline: Bill Ackman’s Big Bet On Meta Stock Is Finally Paying Off: Here’s The 2026 Gain So Far
articles.summary: After taking a beating early in the year, Bill Ackman's massive Meta Platforms position has officially bounced back.
articles._summary: Here’s a look at how much Ackman’s position is up in 2026. Ackman announced the new stake in Meta in an investment presentation in February 2026, before a 13F filing officially unveiled the full size. In the fourth quarter filing, it was unveiled that Pershing Square Capital Management bought 2,673,569 META shares. That position was later slightly reduced to 2,660,861 shares in the first quarter.
articles._zh_headline: 比尔·阿克曼 (Bill Ackman) 对 Meta 股票的大赌注终于得到回报：这是迄今为止 2026 年的收益
articles._zh_summary: 以下是阿克曼的持股在 2026 年上涨了多少。阿克曼在 2026 年 2 月的投资演示中宣布了 Meta 的新股份，随后 13F 文件正式公布了全部规模。在第四季度的文件中，显示 Pershing Square Capital Management 购买了 2,673,569 股 META 股票。该仓位随后在第一季度略有减少至 2,660,861 股。

articles.author: Chris Katje
articles.headline: EXCLUSIVE: Berkshire’s Alphabet, UnitedHealth Buys Show CEO Greg Abel Is Expanding the Playbook, Expert Says
articles.summary: Market expert Jay Woods highlights the ways Greg Abel has made Berkshire Hathaway different since Warren Buffett stepped down as CEO.
articles._summary: Woods said the relationship with Alphabet is surprising. "Here’s a company that’s been around for 25 years. Took them forever to really get involved in Apple and it became a major holding and they made a lot of money off of it. They see the potential here in Alphabet," Woods tells Benzinga. Woods said that the recent 13F shows that Abel isn’t just "looking at the old traditional Warren Buffett investments." "They’re broadening their scope and they are getting involved."
articles._zh_headline: 独家报道：专家称，伯克希尔哈撒韦公司 Alphabet、联合健康集团收购显示首席执行官格雷格·阿贝尔正在扩大策略
articles._zh_summary: 伍兹表示与 Alphabet 的关系令人惊讶。 “这家公司已经存在了 25 年。他们花了很长时间才真正涉足苹果公司，苹果公司成为了他们的主要控股公司，他们从中赚了很多钱。他们看到了 Alphabet 的潜力，”伍兹告诉本津加。伍兹表示，最近的 13F 表明阿贝尔不仅仅“着眼于沃伦·巴菲特的传统投资”。 “他们正在扩大范围并参与其中。”

articles.author: Khyathi Dalal
articles.headline: Standard Chartered Keeps $100,000 Bitcoin Target, Calls Strategy Selloff a 'Communication Challenge'
articles.summary: Standard Chartered has reaffirmed its $100,000 year-end 2026 target for Bitcoin, arguing that recent weakness tied to Strategy reflects a communication challenge, not a deterioration in its financial position. Investors are adjusting to Strategy's transition from a "never sell Bitcoin" model to using BTC as collateral for its preferred stock business.
articles._summary: In a research note on Friday, Geoffrey Kendrick , Standard Chartered’s global head of digital assets research said, “I see what is happening at MSTR right now as a communication challenge, nothing more,” He argued that investors are still adjusting to Strategy’s shift away from its long-standing “never sell Bitcoin” philosophy toward using Bitcoin as collateral to support its growing preferred stock business.
articles._zh_headline: 渣打银行维持 10 万美元比特币目标，称战略抛售是“沟通挑战”
articles._zh_summary: 渣打银行全球数字资产研究主管杰弗里·肯德里克 (Geoffrey Kendrick) 在周五的一份研究报告中表示，“我认为 MSTR 目前发生的情况是一个沟通挑战，仅此而已。”他认为，投资者仍在适应 Strategy 从其长期的“绝不出售比特币”理念转向使用比特币作为抵押品以支持其不断增长的优先股业务的转变。
